tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: gsang bdag phyag rdor gtum po las: tshe sgrub 'chi med btsan rdzong bzhugs:

ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ gtum po rab gsang tshe yi lha tshogs skye 'chi bral: rab tu gus pas phyag 'tshal gang zag skal ldan la: 'chi med tshe yi rig 'dzin stsol mdzad gsang ba'i lha: dus ngan snyigs mar sde brgyad kha phyur dus min 'chi: sman pas ngos 'dzin med pa'i nad rigs sna tshogs 'ong: gdon rigs ma nges du mas skye 'gro 'debs par byed: 'gro ba 'ga' zhig dus min tshe dus gum par byed: de dus 'chi med btsan rdzong gsang ba'i yang gsang 'di: pad 'byung nga yis rgyud sde'i bcud bsdus mnga' bdag don: ma 'ongs 'phrad par smon lam btab nas gsang gter sbas: 'phrad nas skal ldan 'ga' zhig 'chi med lus thob shog: dbang thob dam tshig gtsang ba'i skal ldan 'ga' zung la: gcig rgyud gsang ba'i bzlas lung 'di nyid gtad par gyis: mang du spel na gter ston rang la bar chad 'ong: rang nyams longs la dam tshig mtha' rgya bsgrub la brtson: mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan byung na dam tshig can la spel: sā mā yā: rgya rgya rgya: skyabs 'gro sems bskyed spyi ltar byas la stong par sbyangs: stong pa'i ngang las rang rtsal rig pa'i ngo bo 'di: hūm̐ mthing ma smug nag las 'od zer rab 'phros pas: rang lus mgo mjug med par thams cad mer gyis gang: rang nyid skad cig gtum po yab yum sku ru gyur: pad+ma nyi zla dregs byed ru tra'i gdan steng du: gtum po sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: zhabs ni phyed skyil tshul du 'gying bag gnod byed steng: dbu skra kham nag gyen du 'bar zhing tshwa tshwa 'phro: spyan gsum dmar 'khrug zhal gdang ljags 'dril mche ba gtsigs: khro gnyer dpral bsdus sma ra smin ma ag tshom ser: thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal yan lag sbrul gyis brgyan: phyag gnyis rdo rje dril bu bsnol thabs yum la 'khyud: mi mgo'i do shal stag lpags rlon pa'i sham thabs dkris: mi lpags g.yang gzhi skur gsol glang kos stod g.yog byas:

smin mtshams thal chen tshom bu rak+ta'i thig le'i brgyan: lto bar zhag gi zo ris sku khros sgeg cing dpa': gsang yum dbyings phyug ljang dmar zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma: phyag g.yas bhan+dha yab stob g.yon pas dril 'dzin 'khyud: zhabs gnyis yab 'khril khro mo spyan gsum rus rgyan brgyan: yab yum me dpung 'bar klong ru tra'i steng du gsal: yab yum gnyis kyi spyi bo'i rtsa 'khor rtsa 'dab sum cu gnyis: oṃ dkar rnam snang 'khor lo dril 'dzin sangs rgyas sbyor yum 'khyud: mgrin pa'i rtsa 'khor rtsa 'dab bcu drug snang mtha' yab yum dmar: pad+ma dril 'dzin pad+ma'i yum bcas gri thod 'dzin cing 'khyud: snying ga'i rtsa 'khor rtsa 'dab brgyad la mi bskyod yab dang yum: mthing nag rdo rje dril 'dzin rdo rje'i yum bcas gri thod 'dzin cing 'khyud: lte ba'i rtsa 'khor rtsa 'dab drug cur rin 'byung yab yum ser: rin chen dril 'dzin rat+na'i yum bcas gri thod 'dzin cing 'khyud: gsang ba'i rtsa 'khor rtsa 'dab drug la don grub yab yum ljang: rgya gram dril 'dzin karma'i yum bcas gri thod 'dzin cing 'khyud: de ltar yab yum gsal ba'i rtsa 'khor rtsa 'dab lha tshogs rnams: gsal bskyed thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer phyogs bcu'i zhing du 'phros: thugs rgyud bskul nas sprin ltar gtib rnams gnas lnga'i lhar thim bsgom: hūm̐: lcang lo can dang mngon dga'i zhing: dpal ldan bde chen las rab rdzogs: dag pa'i zhing khams so so nas: spyan drangs gnas lnga'i lha la thim: 'chi med dbang bskur dam ye dbyer med 'dres: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: chu lhag yar lud mi bskyod dbu brgyan gyur: ma yengs ngang du gsang sngags 'bru 'bum bzlas: yab kyi thugs ka'i mi bskyod yab yum gyi: thugs ka'i hūm̐ ma gnyis las sngags phreng thon: mi bskyod zhal nas mgrin pa'i snang mtha' yi: sbyor mtshams zhugs nas zhal thon spyi bo yi:

rnam snang sbyor mtshams nas zhugs zhal nas thon: yab kyi zhal nas yum zhal zhugs te spyi bo yi: rnam snang zhal zhugs sbyor mtshams nas thon mgrin pa yi: snang mtha'i zhal zhugs sbyor mtshams nas thon snying ga yi: mi bskyod zhal zhugs sbyor mtshams nas thon lte ba yi: rin 'byung zhal zhugs sbyor mtshams nas thon gsang ba yi: don grub zhal zhugs sbyor mtshams nas thon yum gyi bha ga nas: yab kyi rdo rje nas brgyud gsang ba'i don grub kyi: sbyor mtshams nas zhugs zhal thon lte ba yi: rin 'byung sbyor mtshams nas zhugs snying ga'i mi bskyod pa'i: sbyor mtshams nas zhugs sngags phreng sngon po ni: phar la mchod cing tshur la dngos grub rnams: stsol bar bsgom zhing bzlas pa nyid la 'bung: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang dang: phyi nang snod bcud skye 'gro thams cad kyi: tshe bsod rang la thim bsgom sngags 'di bzlas: oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa ma ma ā yur+dz+nyā na puṇ+ye puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru tshe bh+rūm̐: zhes pa ma yengs rtse gcig 'bad par bya: thun mtshams dge ba bsngo zhing bskyed rim ni: snod bcud 'od zhu yab yum gnyis la thim: yab yum 'od zhu gnas lnga'i lha la thim: gnas lnga'i lha rnams mi bskyod yab yum la: thim zhing mi bskyod yab yum hūm̐ mar thim: hūm̐ ma thig le nā da zla tshes la: thim zhing yal nas rdzogs chen ngang du bzhag: slar yang zung 'jug phyag rdor sku rkyang gyur: nyams su len pa'i gnas mchog ni: nga yi gter gnas khyad par 'phags: bla ma mkha' 'gros dngos grub ster: mi med lung stong dge sbyor 'phel: ri rtser shes pa dwangs shing gsal: dur khrod nges 'byung skyo shas skye: shin tu dben pas nyams rtogs 'phel: de ltar dben gnas brten pa la: dgos ched gnas skabs mthar thug gnyis: gnas skabs dge sbyor ngang gis 'phel: bar chad mi 'byung dgos ched yod: mthar thug dbyings rig brtan pa thob:

sangs rgyas myur thob dgos ched yod: gnas btsal bsgrub la ma brtson na: gong gi yon tan nyid las ldog: gsang spyod thabs lam nyid la 'bad: mtshan nyid sum ldan phyag rgya bsten: dgos ched gnas skabs mthar thug gnyis: gnas skabs nyon mongs lam du khyer: sa lam yon tan zla ltar 'phel: mthar thug dga' bzhi mthar phyin nas: tshe 'dir sku bzhi thob pa'i dgos ched yod: mtshan nyid ldan pa ma bsten na: gong gi yon tan rnams las ldog: ci phyir mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las: e ma nga yi pad+ma 'di: bde ba thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas: lam ste mchog dga' bzhi ster nas: de yi mdun na bdag 'dug go: sangs rgyas mnyes pa la sogs pa: pad+mo bya ba ci bzhin bya: bde chen rgyal po'i rang bzhin te: 'di nyid du ni rtag tu bzhugs: blun po gang zhig 'di spangs pa: de la mchog gi dngos grub med: nyon mongs 'dod chags la brten tshe sgrub 'di: 'chi med tshe yi btsan rdzong e ma ho: bde chen dag pa'i zhing du e ma ho: bar chad bdud kyis mi tshugs e ma ho: ma 'ongs rtsub 'gyur dus kyi tha ma la: nges med 'chi bdag glo bur 'byung ba'i dus: mnga' bdag rgyal po nyid dang 'phrad par shog: 'phrad nas 'chi med rdo rje'i sku thob shog: 'di la gter ston nyid kyis nan tan sgrubs: gzhan la ma sbyin rang la bar chad 'ong: gtad kyang o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan sgugs: slob ma dad ldan tsam la gcig brgyud spel: gdams so gtad do gza' klu brtan ma'i tshogs: chos bdag bu la sprod cig gter srung rnams: dus min len na srog chod snying khrag thungs: rā hu la nā ga tiṣ+ṭha lhan: sā mā yā: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gter ston ngag gi rdo rje yis: bya lor ja pa brag nas gton: sngon las 'brel ba dge slong rab rgyal gyis: nan gyis dgos zer o rgyan mkha' 'gro la: tshogs 'khor bshams nas drag tu gsol ba btab:

de tshe nyams snang 'khrul snang rmi lam na: o rgyan mkha' 'gro lnga yis bskor ba gcig: byung nas dam tshig gcig pa'i slob ma skal ldan la: ston cig rang nyid sgrub brtson sgrub pa mthar thon gyis: tshe la 'phrang gsum yod pas sgrub pa nar mar gyis: gzhan dbang ma 'gro rang nyams gang shar gyis: o rgyan nga yis mi bslu 'jam dbyangs sprul pa'i sku: gsung snang byung zhing rang snang rang sems 'di: 'gyu ba shar grol ka dag ye dag cing: nyin mtshan 'khor yug dbyer med zhag gcig byung: chos sku o rgyan dngos su mjal ba red: ma nyes rdzun rgan zer yang zhe blo bde: 'on kyang nyon mongs lam du khyer ba 'di: dge slong sdom ldan rnams kyis byar mi rung: dngos su mi bsten lha yi bskyed rim bya: rtsa rlung thig gsum 'dren dang bzlog mkhan gyis: 'di nyid nyams blangs mkha' spyod grub pa 'thob: rdzong brgyad zla bral gnas mchog na bun rdzong: dpal ri pad+ma 'od dang dbyer med cing: rta phag yab yum 'bur sku dod pa'i drung: klu bdud nag po'i gdengs ka bslang ba'i steng: dus mtha'i gter ston ngag gi rdo rje yis: shog ser dri med ngos las me stag lor: bshus pa'i yi ge pa ni dar rgyas so: maṅga laṃ: ༁ྃ: skal ldan smin grol lam mchog bskur ba ni: sngon 'gro bgegs gtor mtshams gcod srung 'khor bsgom: skyabs 'gro sems bskyed spyi gzhung ltar du bya: tshe bum tshe gtor tshe chang sgrub rdzas bsham: de nas dam tshig bsrung ba'i mna' chu sbyin: hūm̐: dam tshig rdo rje chen po'i chu: rigs ldan slob mar sbyin par bya: bsrung na yon tan sna tshogs 'thob: ma bsrung dmyal ba'i gnas su skyel: de bas dam tshig bsrung bar gyis: oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa ma ma ā yur+dz+nyā na puṇ+ye puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru tshe bh+rūm̐: i dan na ra kan: cod pan spyi bor btags byas la: hūm̐: dar tshon cod pan rnam par dag:

ye shes lnga mtshon 'phur lce ldan: ye shes spyan ldan dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa ma ma ā yur+dz+nyā na puṇ+ye puṣ+ṭaṃ ku ru tshe bh+rūm̐: tsak+ṣu pra we sha ya hūm̐ phaṭa: bum pa spyi bor bzhag nas kyang: hūm̐: bum pa bzang po gzhal yas khang: 'chi med bdud rtsi'i bcud kyis bkang: kun bzang rigs lnga rigs gsum mgon: gsang bdag lha tshogs pad 'byung bcas: phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad kyis: ye shes bdud rtsis dbang bskur bas: 'chi med tshe yi dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa ma ma ā yur+dz+nyā na puṇ+ye puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru tshe bh+rūm̐: thod pa mgrin par bzhag pa gtad par bya: hūm̐: thod pa ma chags rtog bral nang: 'chi med rigs lnga yab yum bzhugs: thabs shes rang byung bde ba'i bcud: byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsis bkang: skal ldan bu la sbyin par bya: 'gag med rdo rje'i dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa ma ma ā yur+dz+nyā na= wā ka a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: bum pa thogs la: hūm̐: tshe bum rang bzhin gzhal yas khang: nang na rigs lnga yab yum bzhugs: 'od zer dkar dmar sna tshogs 'phros: sa chu me rlung nam mkha'i bcud: bsdus shing bum pa'i nang du zhugs: byang sems bdud rtsi'i ngo bor zhu: phyir lud slob ma'i lus la thim: nad gdon sdig sgrib zhi gyur nas: 'chi med rdo rje'i sku thob shog: oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā= a bhi ṣiñca oṃ: bum pa thogs la: hūm̐: tshe bum rang bzhin gzhal yas khang: nang na rigs lnga yab yum bzhugs: 'od zer dkar dmar sna tshogs 'phros: dri za gshin rje klu gnod sbyin: rnams kyis tshe srog brkus dang phrogs: bsdus shing bum pa'i nang du zhugs: byang sems bdud rtsi'i ngo bor zhu: phyir lud slob ma'i ngag la thim: ngag gi sgrib pa dag gyur nas: 'gag med tshangs dbyangs drug ldan shog: oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā= a bhi ṣiñca hrī: bum pa thogs la: hūm̐: tshe bum rang bzhin gzhal yas khang:

nang na rigs lnga yab yum bzhugs: 'od zer dkar dmar sna tshogs 'phros: steng phyogs tshangs pa brgya byin gyis: tshe bla srog gsum brkus phrogs rnams: bsdus shing bum pa'i nang du zhugs: byang sems bdud rtsi'i ngo bor zhu: phyir lud slob ma'i yid la thim: yid kyi rnam rtog dag gyur nas: chos dbyings don dang ldan gyur cig: oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa= a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: bum pa thogs la: hūm̐: tshe bum rang bzhin gzhal yas khang: nang na rigs lnga yab yum bzhugs: 'od zer dkar dmar sna tshogs 'phros: sde brgyad byad zor rig sngags kyis: tshe srog bcad bkug khyer ba sogs: bsdus shing bum pa'i nang du zhugs: byang sems bdud rtsi'i ngo bor zhu: phyir lud slob ma'i gsang bar thim: nyon mongs sdig sgrib dag nas kyang: phrin las bzhi 'grub dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa= a bhi ṣiñca trāṃ: slob mar mtshan ldan phyag rgya gtad: slob ma gsang bdag yab yum bskyed: mkha' gsang byin rlabs sbyor ba byed du 'jug: hūm̐: mtshan ldan phyag rgya bde ba skyed pa'i yum: skal ldan khyod la gsang yum sbyin par bya: gnyis med bde ba chen po'i ting 'dzin gyis: thig le pad+ma'i nang du mnyam gnas pa: zag med ye shes rang ngo shes par gyis: oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa ma ma ā yur+dz+nyā na puṇ+ye puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru tshe bh+rūm̐: mu dra a bhi ṣiñca ā: kye: ltos shig rang gi sems la ltos: spros bral thig le nyag gcig 'di: cir yang ma grub ngo bo nyid kyis stong: de ni skye med rig stong chos kyi sku: cir yang gsal ba 'gag med longs spyod rdzogs: gnyis med rang grol lhun grub sprul pa'i sku: stong pa'i rol par ma 'das chos dbyings mkha' la khyab: sangs rgyas rang gis rig pas shes par gyis: g.yo med don la ma yengs mnyam par zhog: sngags phreng gtad la: hūm̐ hūm̐: khyed rang gsang bdag yab yum du: gsal ba'i ljags steng gnam lcags kyi:

rdo rje rtse lnga'i lte ba ru: sngags phreng sngon po'i 'od zer 'phros: gzungs sngags snying po'i drag sngags thim: gsung dbyangs sngags kyi dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa= ma ma ā yur+dz+nyā na puṇ+ye puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru tshe bh+rūm̐: sa bdag klu gnyan rnams kyi gzugs: slob ma'i zhabs kyi 'og tu bting: hūm̐: zil gnon bsgrad pa'i zhabs dkyil 'dir: sa bdag klu gnyan bsnol ba'i dbang: gdug pa can rnams thams cad kun: zil gyis gnon pa'i dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa nā ga ra tsa sa ma ya nan: a bhi ṣiñca oṃ: dbu dgu phyag gnyis chu srin mgo: zhags pa mda' gzhu thod khrag bsnams: sbrul mjug 'khyil ba brgyad rnams bting: hūm̐: bhi nu dmag dpon drang srong dang: ljang sngon rā tsa ro tri dang: mig dmar ser skya la sogs te: gza' brgyad slob ma khyod la gtad: 'gro kun gza' nad las grol shog: oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa ma ma ā yur+dz+nyā na puṇ+ye puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru tshe bh+rūm̐: gza' rā hu la sa ma ya nan a bhi ṣiñca hrī: klu chen brgyad gzugs zhabs su bting: hūm̐: mtha' yas dang ni 'jog po dang: nor rgyas dang ni dung skyong dang: pad+ma dang ni chu lha dang: rigs ldan dang ni stobs kyi rgyu: klu gnyan slob ma khyod la gtad: 'gro ba klu gdon nad kun las: khyod kyis grol ba'i dbang thob shog: oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa ma ma ā yur+dz+nyā na puṇ+ye puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru tshe bh+rūm̐: nā ga ra tsa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: gtor chung nyer brgyad gtad par bya: hūm̐: dkyil 'khor lcags ri'i phyi rol na: gza' dang rgyu skar sde brgyad tshogs: slob ma khyod la gtad par bya: bran dang g.yog bzhin byed par shog: oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa ma ma ā yur+dz+nyā na puṇ+ye puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru tshe bh+rūm̐: a ya ma du ru tsa sha na ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa: sgo ma bzhi'i sku gtad la: hūm̐: 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor sgo nang nas:

sgo ma bzhi yi dbang bskur bas: phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub: dbang mchog dus 'dir thob par shog: oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa ma ma ā yur+dz+nyā na puṇ+ye puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru tshe bh+rūm̐: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: a bhi ṣiñca oṃ: de nas tshe gtor gtad la: hūm̐: gtor ma bdud rtsi'i pho brang nas: rdo rje tshe yi lha tshogs kyis: 'chi med tshe yi dbang mchog skur: nad med bde ba bstsal du gsol: oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa ma ma ā yur+dz+nyā na puṇ+ye puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru tshe bh+rūm̐: rgyud sde kun gyi bcud phyung ba: tshe sgrub rnams kyi snying po 'di: ma 'ongs dus ngan shar ba'i tshe: snying gi bu dang 'phrad par shog: 'phrad nas 'gro kun sgrol bar shog: dam log bdud rigs dam nyams la: ma shor gza' klus thub par srungs: sa ma ya: sku rgya: gsung rgya: thugs rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gnyan rgya: gsang rgya: mkhar chen gza' mtsho rgyal gyis yi ger bris te gter du sbas pa'o:
rig 'dzin ngag gi rdo rjes gnas mchog ja pa brag nas gdan drangs pa'o// maṅga laṃ/// /
